title: AP decisions & schemes: Sep-Oct 2026
quote: Amarajeevi Jaladhara: ₹30,156 crore to bring tap water to rural habitations under Jal Jeevan Mission 2.0

boxes.title: Amarajeevi Jaladhara (JJM 2.0)
items: Launched by CM **N. Chandrababu Naidu**, ==**Proddatur, Kadapa**== on **5 Oct 2026**
Investment **₹30,156 crore**; household tap connections
**90 lakh households**, ~**48,000 rural habitations**, ~**3.30 crore** people (⚠ other notes: **3.27 crore**)
**13,075 overhead tanks**; target **61.60 lakh** tap connections
Norm: **55 litres** per person per day
⚠ Focus = **rural** habitations, not urban
**JJM**: **2019**, **Ministry of Jal Shakti**

cards.title: PMAY-U 2.0
lines: Award on **World Habitat Day** (first Monday of Oct; since **1986**)

boxes.title: Sanjeevani: tribal strategy (Araku)
head: Area
Initiative
rows: **Tribal Health Infrastructure Mission** **₹250 crore**; **104** ambulances, **42** tests

boxes.title: Organ Transplantation Amendment 2026
items: **AP Act No. 25 of 2026**; based on **Jeevandan** proposals
Covers **tissues**: skin, cornea, heart valves, bone marrow
==**Grandparents & grandchildren**== added as near relatives
**Swap transplantation** recognised; THOTA **1994**, amended **2011**

boxes.title: Tirumala & TTD

boxes.title: Pulicat & apprenticeship

**State Apprenticeship Council**: chair **Principal Secretary, Skill Development**
**NAPS 2.0**: **Apprentices Act, 1961**; Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
